name: VEROlabs Exploring Sound
summary:
Get ready for an exciting journey into the world of sound! Put on your headset and explore up close how acoustic waves travel, interact with spaces, and shape our auditory perception.

In this interactive VR experience, you will be able to:
• Measure and distinguish sound wave frequency (Hz), amplitude (dB SPL), and wavelength (m), and observe their direct effects on pitch and loudness
• Apply the inverse square law to measure and predict how sound intensity decreases with distance from a point source
